explication: Cobalt is a browser-based downloader backed by an API that resolves public media links and provides download or streaming responses; it also supports client-side processing. The principal user flow is link submission, API request, then download, selection, or local processing. The web task manager coordinates fetch and FFmpeg workers, while settings and file storage support configurable and local workflows. The README describes the API as a non-caching proxy. Some internal API wiring is unsampled, so those call relationships are intentionally omitted.
